decisions.reason: The accelerator program has home-page visibility but no flagship status, and its lower sunk investment relative to core hardware means management is somewhat more willing to drop it, though early disappointments are still likely attributed to temporary start-up conditions.
As a publicly announced flagship with a dedicated web page and major development investment, strong escalation-of-commitment pressures make an early drop highly unlikely.

Its prominent launch as a flagship on the home page and the quantified public announcement create high sunk-cost and justification pressures, so the firm will likely persist despite any early disappointments.

The mobile recycling plant is close to the established offer and was specifically launched on the home page, signaling meaningful public commitment and investment, so early problems are likely treated as temporary and the product kept.
